messages:
rachel: Kickoff for Launchpad RefApp mini series. Need announcement post, webinar, reproducible benchmarks, and inbound routing. Primary CTA: clone tutorial repo and join cohort slack.

pete: I can draft the blog and landing. Hero line idea: Start a working RefApp in under an hour with our tutorial. Keep exact bench numbers in an appendix.

anya: I'll run the live demo and design the hands on lab. Suggest 20m demo + 30m lab so folks leave with a cloned example.

marc: I'll generate a small benchmark notebook and a short table for the post: median latency, cost per 1k tokens, and quantized tradeoffs. Will include scripts to reproduce.

rachel: Inbound routing plan: webhook to CRM with tags source=launchpad-refapp and interest=tutorial. Post hot leads to #devrel-inbound-launchpad.

pete: Landing form fields: email, company, role, primary use case, opt in for workshop follow up. Match webhook keys.

devrel-bot: Created channel #devrel-inbound-launchpad and posted webhook URL.

anya: Repo plan: org/launchpad-refapp with minimal quickstart, demo notebook, bench notebook, and contributing guide. Will open PR by next week.

marc: Quick bench preview: baseline fp16 ~100ms per token median, int8 ~65ms with small eval delta. I'll add a reproducible harness and a notebook with commands.

rachel: Timeline: landing + post draft by Sep 14, repo + lab by Sep 22, bench notebook by Sep 25, webinar week Oct 3. Any objections?

pete: No objections. I'll share first draft today for quick review.

anya: I'll prepare slides and the lab script. Also add a tiny workshop followup template for devrel.

rachel: Great. I'll make a tiny tracker doc and loop in comms for distribution. Thanks all
